verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Workers docs say Bindings connect code to databases, APIs, and storage 'with just a few lines of code', and that its data products can be queried 'directly from Workers with no connection management'. Concrete binding usage (env.Sandbox) and an AI Search Workers binding are documented, and a community user reports shipping a KV-backed API to production within an hour. Missing for 10: detailed binding configuration docs, explicit evidence that bindings remove credential handling, and evidence of bindings to third-party (non-Cloudflare) databases beyond the headline claim.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my code to external services like databases, APIs, and storage through native bindings with minimal boilerplate instead of hand-wiring SDKs and credentials
